title: Search resilience — timeout + retry/backoff wrapper degrading flaky search to [] (Epic 3)
prompt:
Wrap provider calls with a timeout and retry/backoff; return an empty list (not an exception) on persistent failure, logged.

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

note: Fourth task of Epic 3 (pluggable web search, docs/prds/search-plugin.md §6 + PRD §5.5): the search layer's own graceful-degradation wrapper, so a flaky/failed search never crashes a debate. Added search/resilient.py: ResilientSearchProvider — a transparent decorator implementing the SearchProvider Protocol (name passthrough + search). Per call it runs the inner provider's search under a thread-based timeout, retries transient failures (TimeoutError/ConnectionError) with exponential backoff, and on persistent failure returns [] (never raising) and logs the degradation. Reuses the gatekeeper's existing retry policy (run_with_retry/backoff_delay from gatekeeper/_retry.py) instead of duplicating backoff — this wrapper is complementary to Epic 13 (gatekeeper = rate/throughput retry; this = 'never throw to the caller, return [] on failure'). No-hard-coded-values: max_retries + retry_after_seconds come from the search service ServiceLimits (config/rate_limits.json: max_retries=2, retry_after_seconds=15), timeout_s from config (Settings.turn_timeout_s); sleep_fn + timeout_runner are injected seams so tests assert exact backoff delays with no real sleeping. Timeout approach (search/_timeout.py: run_with_timeout): runs the synchronous inner call on a daemon worker thread and join(timeout_s); if still alive -> raise TimeoutError (a transient error that retries, then degrades to []); daemon thread so a hung call never blocks process exit. Logging split into search/_resilient_log.py (_ResilientLog): a retry event per scheduled retry and a timeout event on persistent degradation, emitted via the LOG package to runs/<run_id>.jsonl. Re-exported ResilientSearchProvider from search/__init__ and agent_debate.core. TDD red-first: wrote test_search_resilience.py (6 tests: transient-then-success returns results after logged retries with asserted backoff [2.0,4.0]; always-failing returns [] + logs a timeout event; timeout path returns [] + logs; empty inner results pass through as []; a genuinely slow inner call (timeout_s=0) is caught and degrades to []; wrapper isinstance SearchProvider), watched it fail (ModuleNotFoundError), implemented to green. All gates green locally: uv sync clean; ruff check = All checks passed; ruff format --check clean; mypy = no issues in 78 source files; pytest --cov = 280 passed, 100% total coverage (resilient.py / _timeout.py / _resilient_log.py all 100%, >=85 required); check_line_limit.py rc=0 (all new files well under 150 code lines); secret_scan.py rc=0. docs/PROMPTS.md entry added.
